page_title: EIN 3-1 HOF | Eintracht Frankfurt v Hoffenheim 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 57100.
90+4' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle as Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+4' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes onto the pitch so that Tuta can be given a rest.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' A thunderous effort from long range by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) goes well wide of the left post.
88' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
87' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
87' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
85' Here comes a substitution. Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Grischa Promel.

84' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a huge opportunity. He attempts to knock a rebound into the middle of the goal with a delicate header, but Oliver Baumann dives to keep the ball from hitting the net.

84' Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Oliver Baumann pulls off an easy save.
83' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
80' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Niels Nkounkou is replaced by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
80' Substitution. Omar Marmoush is replaced by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
79' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Mario Gotze and he is replaced by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
77' Florian Micheler (Hoffenheim) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle after Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
74' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
73' Substitution. Alexander Prass will be replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim).
72' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
72' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
71' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
70' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
68' Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
66' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
65' It is time for a substitution. Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) is on for Hugo Ekitike.
65' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle after Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
64' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Florian Micheler (Hoffenheim) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

61' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
60' Florian Badstubner has a clear sight and sees a foul from Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt).
59' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florian Micheler (Hoffenheim) replacing Dennis Geiger.
58' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
56' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Mario Gotze tees up Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Oliver Baumann.

54' 2 - 1 Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) meets a perfect cross from Adam Hlozek deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner via the post. It's 2:1.
53' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort high over the bar.
52' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
51' The free kick picks out Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) in space, but his close-range header flies miles over the bar.
50' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' The ball is cleared after Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
47' Hoffenheim control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The game is over for Marius Bulter. Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Pellegrino Matarazzo probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Tim Drexler. He is replaced by Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' That's unlucky! Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
45+1' CLOSE! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
40' Great teamplay by Eintracht Frankfurt as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
40' Pellegrino Matarazzo (Hoffenheim) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
39' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
36' Hoffenheim are ruled offside.
35' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
33' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Hugo Ekitike feeds Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
32' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and it's Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
32' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
29' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
27' The referee blows for a cooling break.

27' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
24' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Omar Marmoush tees up Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box and he slams the ball past Oliver Baumann.
24' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) prepares to take a corner kick.
23' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
23' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Hoffenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
21' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) attempts to release Andrej Kramaric with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
20' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
18' A pass by Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
16' A great run from Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post.
15' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
12' One of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
12' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
11' Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a free kick.
11' Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim) has tested the patience of referee Florian Badstubner and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
10' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) sends a long ball in, but Kevin Trapp comfortably gathers the ball.
8' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
7' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
5' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
4' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
3' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
2' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Hoffenheim will take the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
